title: The Last Entry in the Horizon Notebook

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: After many evenings of guessing, the village scholar opens the Horizon Notebook to write the season's final entry.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After many evenings of guessing, (name1), the village scholar, opens the Horizon Notebook to write the season's final entry.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The scholar writes it plainly, and everyone agrees it is the most honest entry.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A child adds, "But we wonder," and the scholar keeps it.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The scholar writes that distant people, if they exist, might be kind, curious and a little like Isolans.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A skeptic asks that "might" be underlined twice, and it is.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The scholar leaves it blank for the next generation to fill.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Someone draws a small wave on it, and the scholar decides that says enough.
